mapper.select:
select `saleinfo`.*, `druginfo`.`drug_code` as drugCode, `druginfo`.`drug_name` as drugName from `saleinfo` left join `druginfo` on `saleinfo`.`druginfo_id` = `druginfo`.id
and `druginfo`.`drug_code` like concat ('%', #{drugCode}, '%')
and `druginfo`.`drug_name` like concat ('%', #{drugName}, '%')
and `saleinfo`.`return_apply` like concat ('%', #{returnApply}, '%')
and `saleinfo`.`return_pos` like concat ('%', #{returnPos}, '%')
